svg.aria-label: Citeline, ai product. Chat with your documents, with citations you can actually check. Upload a PDF, ask a question and get a streamed answer. Every claim shows the file, the page and the exact excerpt it came from. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, AI SDK, Postgres + pgvector, Drizzle.
